TokenSave Data

Measurements we ran ourselves on AI tokens and costs, published as open datasets. Each page has the headline numbers, the full table, a CSV download, the method and its limits, and a ready-made citation. Everything is free to reuse under CC BY 4.0 with a link back.

All datasets

  • Token cost by language: 41 languages measured on GPT tokenizers The same prompt in 41 languages: +3% to +144% more GPT tokens than English. CSV · updated 2026-10-16
  • Token cost by language on Claude, Gemini and GPT: 41 languages measured The same prompt on Claude 5.5, Claude Haiku 4.5, Gemini and GPT: Korean needs 89 Claude tokens vs 49 on GPT. CSV · measured 2026-10-17
  • Token cost by data format: JSON vs YAML vs CSV vs TOON on Claude, Gemini and GPT The same table in 8 formats on 4 tokenizers: CSV needs about two thirds fewer tokens than indented JSON. CSV · measured 2026-10-17
  • Image input token cost by resolution: Claude vs Gemini vs GPT One image at 10 resolutions on Claude, Gemini and GPT: Gemini charges a flat ~1,100 tokens, GPT-6 Astra up to 14,364. CSV · measured 2026-10-18
  • Token cost by programming language: the same programs in 10 languages on Claude, Gemini and GPT The same two programs in 10 programming languages: C needs 90% more GPT tokens than Python. CSV · measured 2026-10-18
  • PDF token cost per page: Claude vs Gemini, and PDF vs pasted text PDF pages on Claude and Gemini vs pasting the text: Gemini charges a flat 560 tokens per page. CSV · measured 2026-10-18
  • Claude effort levels: tokens, time and cost for the same coding task One coding task at every Claude effort level: $0.56 at medium, $5.25 at max. CSV · measured 2026-10-09
  • Claude Code vs Codex: startup tokens, MCP tools and the same coding task Startup tokens, MCP tool overhead and the same coding task: Codex used about half the tokens of Claude Code. CSV · measured 2026-10-18
  • Web search in Claude Code and Codex: tokens, searches and sources per question Four kinds of question with web search on: tokens, searches, time and the sites seen and cited. CSV · measured 2026-10-18
  • AI web search by language: what Claude Code and Codex search for, and cite, in 5 languages Claude Code and Codex in 5 languages: English searches for AI topics, local-language searches for Seoul, Tokyo, Madrid and Kyiv. CSV · measured 2026-10-19
  • CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md size: what instruction files cost in Claude Code and Codex A 50 KB CLAUDE.md adds about 16,000 tokens to every request; Codex reads only the first 32 KiB of AGENTS.md. CSV · measured 2026-10-18
  • Coding in your own language: does the prompt language change what Claude Code and Codex cost? The same coding task in 5 prompt languages: almost the same tokens, but the game and its comments follow your language. CSV · measured 2026-10-19
  • What the Claude Code harness costs: plugins, subagents, plan mode, skills and hooks on the same task One coding task under 7 Claude Code settings: the harness is 90% of the input, a subagent costs +128%, unused plugins still add tokens. CSV · measured 2026-10-19
  • Vibe coding with Claude Haiku, Sonnet and Opus 5.5: cost, time and whether the game works Three browser games by Claude Haiku, Sonnet and Opus 5.5: all 45 passed play tests, Haiku cost about 95% less. CSV · measured 2026-10-20
  • Long chat or new chat? What 30 requests cost in one Claude Code session, with /compact, and in fresh sessions 30 change requests three ways: a new session per request cost 129% more than one long chat. CSV · measured 2026-10-20
  • Does being polite to AI cost more? Plain, polite and very polite prompts in Korean, Japanese and English Greetings and thanks double the prompt in Korean, Japanese and English, but add only a few percent to the cost. CSV · measured 2026-10-20
  • The coffee-break tax: what your next Claude Code message costs after a 0 to 65 minute pause Pauses of up to 55 minutes cost nothing extra; after 65 minutes the cache was gone and the next message cost about 500% more. CSV · measured 2026-10-20
  • Text as images to cut AI tokens: an independent check of pxpipe on Claude Six documents as text and as pxpipe images on four Claude models: 64% to 81% fewer input tokens, but ids outside the factsheet were read 0 of 80 times. CSV · measured 2026-10-21
  • Claude Code baseline tokens by version: what every request carries before you type The prompt “a” on Claude Code versions from July 2025 to today: the baseline rose 86% to May 2026, then fell back to half that by October. CSV · measured 2026-10-21
  • Browser MCP token cost: Playwright MCP vs Chrome DevTools MCP, and what a snapshot diet saves Playwright MCP and Chrome DevTools MCP in Claude Code, 94 runs: everyday tasks stay small, but one full snapshot of a long page is over 200,000 tokens; our tokensave-mcp-diet proxy cuts it 99%. CSV · measured 2026-10-22
  • Blender MCP token cost: 72 Claude Code runs, from a table and chairs to a racing scene MCP for Blender in Claude Code, 72 runs: everyday tasks $0.16 to $0.23, a racing scene with a chase camera about $0.47; a long property dump $0.87, or $0.17 through tokensave-mcp-diet. CSV · measured 2026-10-22
  • Antigravity CLI vs Claude Code vs Codex: startup tokens, MCP tools and the same coding task Google's Antigravity CLI (the Gemini CLI replacement) against Claude Code and Codex, 44 runs: the same Opus 5.5 read 68% to 88% fewer input tokens in Antigravity for the same game, and all 12 games worked. CSV · measured 2026-10-22
  • Same code, about 60% more output tokens: Claude vs GPT vs Gemini in four coding tools and five languages 80 runs of one coding task in Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity CLI, prompted in five languages: Claude Opus 5.5 spent about 60% more output tokens per character of code than Gemini or GPT. CSV · measured 2026-10-23
